crossRefs.note: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to Yahweh.
But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No; but we will have a king over us,
that we also may be like all the nations, and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”
Isn’t it wheat harvest today? I will call to Yahweh, that he may send thunder and rain; and you will know and see that…

you shall surely set him whom Yahweh your God chooses as king over yourselves. You shall set as king over you one from…

I have given you a king in my anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.

translations.web: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”
translations.bsb: “Look,” they said, “you are old, and your sons do not walk in your ways. Now appoint a king to judge us like all the other nations.”
translations.kjv: And said unto him, Behold, thou art old, and thy sons walk not in thy ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.
translations.asv: and they said unto him, Behold, thou art old, and thy sons walk not in thy ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.
